translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

book.name: JON
book.title: No Tahut na Hinhinawas JON ga Pakat Ie.

content: Jisas ga hapalaine no hahin me Samaria utano lotu tutun.
Io, ira Parisi diet ga hadade bia Jisas ga lamlamus haleng ma ga baptais ra haleng na bulu na harausur ta ing tane Jon.
(Iesen pai tutun bia Jisas ga baptais tari. Iesen ira uno bulu na harausur sen mon kaik, diet ga gilgil baptais.)
Ing bia Jisas ga nunure ing diet ga tangtange, ga haan sukun no hanuo Iudeia, ma ga haan tapukus baling uram Galili.
Ma no ngaas nong ga murmur ie, ga kutus no hanuo Samaria.
Io, ga hanuat taar tiga taman, di kilam ie bia Sikaar, narakoman tano hanuo Samaria. Ma iakano taman i hutet tano katona pise Iakop gate hatinaan no natine ne Iosep mei.
Ma no lulur na taah nong Iakop ga kil ie i kis kaia. Ma bia gate hutet ra tingena kasakes, Jisas ga me kis taar kaia tano gagena lulur kanong ga ubal ie no ngaas.
Ma tiga hahin me Samaria ga hanuat wara kulpa taah. Ma Jisas ga tange tana bia, “Iau sip bia nu hamamo iau ta taah.”
(Io, ira uno bulu na harausur diet gate haan laah ukaia tano taman wara kul nian.)

No hahin me Samaria ga tange balik tana, “Augu tiga Iudeia, ma iau, a Samaria iau. Ma wara bih u saring iau wara gaiena taah?” (Io, ga tange huo kanong ira Iudeia diet pai harbalaan taar ma ira Samaria.)

Io, Jisas ga balui, gaam tange, “Bia u gate nunure tar no hartabar tane God, ma sige mah iau ing iau saring ugu wara gaiena taah, io, u gor te saring iau ta taah, ma iau gor te tar nora taah a lilonai taam.”
No hahin ga tange tana bia, “Awai ra tunaan, taie tiga linge bia nu gagop mei kanong no lulur i manga hansur. Nu kap iakano lilona taah meh?
U lik bia u tamat tano hintubu mehet Iakop? Aie at nong ga tar iakan ra lulur na taah ta het. Ma aie mah ga mom kaia, ira natine, ma ira uno huna bulumakau ma ira sipsip mah.”
Ma Jisas ga balui bia, “Diet bakut ing diet mom ta iakan ra taah, diet na maruk balin.
Iesen bia sige ing na mom tano taah iau ni hamamoi mei, pa na maruk tun at, kanong no taah iau ni tar tana na ngan hora puat narako tana. Ma na pupuat hut, kaik na tar nora nilon hathatika tana.”
No hahin ga tange tana, “Awai, iau sip bia nu hamamo iau ma iakano ra taah, kaik iau pa nigi maruk baling ma iau pa nigi la hanhanuat baal ukai wara kunulup.”
Io, Jisas ga tange tana, “Nu haan, nugu a lamus leh no num tunaan, ma nu lam ie ukai.”
No hahin ga tange tana, “Taie nugu ta tunaan.” Ma Jisas ga tange tana, “U te tange ra tutun ing u tange bia taie num ta tunaan.
Warah, a liman na tunaan u gate tole tar, ma nong um mur kiskis mei kaiken, pai num tunaan tutun ie. Io, pau le harabota ta iakan.”
Io, no hahin ga tange tana, “Awai, iau nas bia a tangesot ugu.

Io, kaiken baak iau wara tirtiri ugu tiga linge. Ira hintubu mehet diet ga lotu tupas God ta iakananam ra uladih. Iesen muat ira Iudeia muat la tangtange bia da lotu tupas God aram sen mon Ierusalem. Ma augu, u lik hohe?”
Ma Jisas ga tange tana bia, “Awai ra hahin, nu nurnur tagu. A pakana bung i hanhanuat bia ira matanaiabar diet pa na lotu tupas Mama aram ta iakananam ra uladih ma taie mah aram Ierusalem.
Muat ira Samaria muat pai nunure nong muat la lalotu tupas ie. Iesen mehet ira Iudeia, mehet nunure tar nong mehet la lalotu tupas ie, kanong no harhalon ta God i hanuat mekaia ta ira Iudeia.

No pakana bung i hanhanuat, ma kaiken mah i te hanuat um bia diet ing diet na lotu tupas God ma ra tutun, diet na lotu hoken. Diet na lotu tupas Mama ta ira tanua diet ma ra tutun na harnunurai mah utana. Io, ma iakan ra mangana lotu, Mama i sip bia da lotu tupas ie huo.
God i tanuo, ma diet ing diet na lotu tupas ie, diet na lotu sen mon ta ira tanua diet ma ra tutun na harnunurai mah utana.”
No hahin ga tange tana, “Iau nunure bia no Mesaia, aie nong di kilam ie bia Krais, na hanuat. Ma bia na hanuat, na hapalaine ira linge bakut ta mehet.”
Io, Jisas ga tange balik tana, “Iau at mon ie.”
Jisas ga haminas tiga malalar utano matmatuko na lalong bia i haruat ma ira haleng na matanaiabar ing diet taguro wara hathatur kawase nora nilon hathatika.

Kaik at mon, ira uno bulu na harausur diet ga tapukus, diet gaam karup bia Jisas dir ga wawor ma tiga hahin. Iesen taie tikai ta diet pa ga tirii bia ga wawor ma iakano hahin warah, ma ra sa dir ga tangtange.

Io, no hahin ga waak kapis tar no uno pala taah, io, gaam tapukus baal tano uno taman, gaam a tange ta ira matanaiabar bia, “Muat mai, muat naga nas tiga tunaan nong i te hinawase iau ta ira linge iau gate gil. Iakanin dak no Mesaia?”
Io, diet ga haan laah mekaia ra taman, diet gaam haan ukaia ho ie.
Bia ira matanaiabar kana baak na ngaas, ira bulu na harausur diet ga tirii, diet gaam tange tana, “Tena harausur, mehet sip bia nu iaan.”
Iesen ga tange ta diet, “Agu mon nian kana ing muat pai nunure.”
Ma ira uno bulu na harausur diet ga tangtange harbasiane ta diet bia, “Ta tiga nong dak i te kap hawaat ana ta nian?”
Io, Jisas ga tange ta diet, “No ragu nian, aie bia iau ni gil haruatne ira sinisip ta nong ga tule iau ma ni hapataam mah ing ga tule iau bia ni gil.

Bia muat la saso ira numuat lalong, muat la tangtange bia a liman ma iruo na teka baak wara kinkilaan. Iesen iau tange ta muat, muat nes baak ira lalong. I te madar bakut um ira pakana wara kinkilaan.
Kaiken at mon, nong i kiikil, i hatur kawase ira hunena no uno mangason ma i bulbul hulungan ira nian utano nilon hathatika. Ma i ngan huo waing nong i saso ma nong mah i kikil, dir na guama tika.
Io, i tale bia na tutun bia tikai na saso ma tiga mes na kikil. Na tutun hoken.
Iau te tule muat bia muat na kil ing muat pa ga so. Ira mes diet ga gil no dadas na pinapalim ma muat te kap leh um ira hunena ira udiet mangason.”
A haleng na Samaria diet ga nurnur tane Jisas.
Ma haleng ta ira Samaria mekaia ta iakano taman, diet ga nurnur tane Jisas kanong no hahin gate hinawas utana hoken: “I te hinawase iau ta ira linge ing iau gate gil.”
Io, bia ira Samaria diet ga haan tupas Jisas, diet ga saring ie bia na kis kaia ho diet, ma ga kis tika ma diet airuo bung.
Ma bia diet ga hadade no uno hinhinawas, a haleng baling diet ga nurnur tana.

Ma diet ga tange tano hahin bia, “Mehet pai nurnur tana ta ira num hinhinawas mon. Taie. Mehet nurnur kanong mehet at, mehet te hadadei, ma i palai ta mehet bia iakan ra tunotuno, aie at no Ut na Harhalon utano ula hanuo.”
Jisas ga halangalanga tiga bulu i hutet bia na maat.
Ma bia Jisas gate kis kaia airuo bung, ga haan laah uram Galili.
(Io, Jisas gate hinawas ra tutun bia tiga tangesot, pa da ru ie tano uno hanuo tun at.)
Ma bia ga hanuat aram Galili, ira matanaiabar mekaia diet ga guama leh ie kanong diet gate nes ira linge gate gil aram Ierusalem tano Nian na Hinahaan Sakit. Warah, diet mah, diet ga haan ukaia.
Mekaia ga haan balin uram Kena, tiga taman ta iakano hanuo Galili, ing baak gate pukusane ira taah, gaam wain kaia. Ma tiga tamat na tunotuno ta ira harkurai, no natine ga maset ares Kapeneam.
Ma bia ga hadade bia Jisas gate hanuat aram Galili meram Iudeia, ga haan ukaia ho ie, gaam saring ie bia na haan naga halangalanga no natine nong ga hutet bia na maat.
Ma Jisas balik ga tange tana, “Ing bia muat pa na nas ira dadas na hakilang ma ira tamat na gingilaan na kinarup muat pa na nurnur at.”
Io, no tamat ta ira harkurai ga tange tane Jisas bia, “Awai ra watong, mai! Dar gi hansur uras. No natigu kabi maat.”
Jisas ga tange tana, “Kaia. Nu haan. No natim i te langalanga.” No tunaan ga nurnur ta ira nianga Jisas ga tange, gaam haan laah.
Bia ga hanahaan baak na ngaas, ga harsomane ira auno tultulai, diet ga hinawasei bia no natine i te langalanga.
Ma ga tiri diet bia a pakana bung sa ing no natine ga langalanga. Io, diet ga balui bia, “Nabung, namur dahin tano tingena kasakes, kaik no mamahien i pataam sukun ie.”
Ma no ana sus ga nunure kilam bia iakano pakana bung tun at bia Jisas ga tange tar tana bia no natine te langalanga. Io, aie ma ing diet la kiskis tika mei, diet ga nurnur.
Ma iakan no airuo na dadas na hakilang ing Jisas ga gil ie aram Galili ing gate haan sukun tar Iudeia.
